scope: National Assembly election of 11 and 25 April 2010 under Act XXXIV of 1989, all 386 seats: round-1 and round-2 registers and participation with the printed turnout, territorial-list votes and seats of every list, national sums of single-member candidate votes per nominating organisation in each round (votes only), national compensation fragment votes and seats, and the final composition (176 + 146 + 64), from the National Election Office's 2010 archive pages; statutory tiers (176 / up to 152 / at least 58) from its description of the seat allocation. Per-constituency and per-district results, invalid ballots per ballot type and candidates are not covered.

owner_decisions.decision: Owner reply: national figures on Copyright Act § 1(4), a reading of the statute weaker than a licence; no candidate names.
Owner reply: extend that reading to the office's composition pages for aggregate seat counts.
Owner brief 'historical election data gap closure' naming the 2010 eredind.htm, l50.htm and mandleir.htm pages on static.valasztas.hu, and answer 'National figures per tier (Recommended)'.

reuse_right.basis: As for 2014–2026: official result publications of the election office, read under the owner's Copyright Act § 1(4) reading; no licence exists.

normalized_republication.basis: National counts, national sums per ballot and per tier, and seat counts; no per-constituency rows; no candidate names; one organisation label containing a person's name stored without it (checksum kept).

raw_redistribution.basis: The pages were read in a browser and are not saved; only the transcribed figures are committed.

acquisition_route.basis: Nine named pages under /dyn/pv10/outroot/ on static.valasztas.hu (robots.txt allows all paths) read once each by hand, following links from the owner-named index; www.valasztas.hu not contacted; no data endpoint requested.

source_files_complete.basis: Both round summaries, the threshold page, both national-totals pages (all 20 single-member nominating groups and all 10 territorial-list organisations), the compensation page (6 national lists) and the composition page.

national_definition_complete.basis: reconcile2010: registers and participation add up in both rounds and reproduce the printed turnouts (64.38%, 46.66%); round 2 in exactly the 57 undecided constituencies; territorial-list votes = 5,132,531; printed thresholds reproduce (5% exceeded, 10% reached for the two-party list) and match the seat-holding lists; territorial seats = 146; compensation seats = 58 + 6 and D'Hondt over the printed fragment votes reproduces 21/3/29/11; single-member seats 119 + 57 = 176 and per organisation; composition rows equal the tiers and total 386 with no vacancy.

same_election_identity_complete.basis: Territorial-list organisations and single-member nominating groups are separate contestants of the 2010 election; FIDESZ-KDNP stays one joint entity (the threshold page's halving is not used); the national list printed as CIVILEK is not matched; no link to any other election.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: From the office's 2010 description of the seat allocation: 386 seats, two rounds, 176 / 152 / 58 statutory tiers, 5% and 10% thresholds, transfer of unallocated territorial seats, D'Hondt for compensation seats. Act XXXIV of 1989 itself was not read; the 15% rule for joint lists of three or more parties is not printed there and is not asserted.

vintage_decisions_complete.basis: Round-1 pages updated 15 April 2010 and round-2 pages 11 May 2010; the composition prints 386 mandates obtained and none vacant. Polling days from the page headings.

continuity: None: no party register reviewed; no link to 2014 or later elections.
